instruction: I need to change my time zone to Pacific Standard Time (PST, UTC-8).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting timezone to PST (UTC-8). The evaluator checks timedatectl output for -0800 offset.
